links.outcome: Consistency and comprehensibility of source citations in ChatGPT migraine responses
links.effect: Source citations were inconsistent and sometimes not comprehensible, which reduced overall comprehensibility of the information. No numeric results reported.
links.quote: However, source citations were found to be inconsistent and, in some cases, not comprehensible, which affected the overall comprehensibility of the information.

screen.reason: Empirical qualitative evaluation of ChatGPT's appropriateness, accuracy, and tone as an information source for simulated migraine scenarios.
